comments.body: Repro'd with k6: pool maxes at 20 conns, requests queue and time out. Bumping the pool hides it but the leak is in the retry path.
Password rotated. Masking rule PR is up; leaving this In Progress until CI confirms no new hits.
Review feedback: dead-letter queue needs an alert, otherwise failures just move somewhere quieter.
